## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

**Date:** 2026-06-09  
**Link:** [Anthropic — Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5)  
**Summary:** Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5, its first generally available Mythos-class model, priced at $10/M input tokens and $50/M output tokens. The model routes some cybersecurity, biology/chemistry, and distillation requests to Claude Opus 4.8. Claude Mythos 5 uses the same underlying model with fewer safeguards for restricted Project Glasswing and future trusted-access users.  
**Why it matters:** Anthropic is separating general commercial access from controlled high-capability access, signaling a more explicit tiering of frontier capability by risk profile and customer trust.

**Date:** 2026-06-09  
**Link:** [OpenAI — Introducing new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind](https://openai.com/index/introducing-new-capabilities-to-gpt-rosalind/)  
**Summary:** OpenAI added new GPT-Rosalind capabilities combining GPT-5.5 agentic coding and tool use with stronger life-sciences performance across medicinal chemistry, genomics, analysis, design, and experimental workflows.  
**Why it matters:** OpenAI is pushing specialized frontier-model capability deeper into drug-discovery workflows, where tool use, domain reasoning, and experimental planning are commercially valuable.
